title: The bandit camp
Bandits on the road
summary: Bandits have made camp {distance} to the {direction} of {settlement} and rob whoever passes. {giver} wants them gone.
offer: There is smoke on the hill {direction} of here most nights, and carts come in robbed. Bandits — {distance} out. Clear them off.
progress: Still robbing the carts, they are.
complete: The road is clear. Well fought.
